<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    height: 100%;
    background: #070914;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  body {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(90, 130, 255, 0.25);
    cursor: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  // ---------- Setup ----------
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = 800, H = 600;
  const HUD_H = 44;
  const FONT = '"Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif';

  function resize() {
    const scale = Math.min(window.innerWidth / W, window.innerHeight / H) * 0.96;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.style.width = Math.floor(W * scale) + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = Math.floor(H * scale) + 'px';
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.floor(W * scale * dpr));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.floor(H * scale * dpr));
    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const PADDLE_W = 110, PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40, PADDLE_SPEED = 640;
  const BALL_R = 8;
  const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;      // max angle from vertical off the paddle
  const SPEED_STEP = 2.5;              // ball speeds up a bit on every brick hit
  const MAX_SPEED = 600;
  const LEVEL_BONUS = 500;

  const COLS = 10, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_MARGIN = 30, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_TOP = 80;
  const BRICK_W = (W - BRICK_MARGIN * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff5e7e', '#ff9f43', '#feca57', '#1dd1a1', '#54a0ff', '#a29bfe', '#ff6bcb'];
  const STEEL = '#b8c4d6', STEEL_CRACKED = '#7d8a9c';

  // '1' = normal brick (1 hit), '2' = silver brick (2 hits), '.' = empty
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 340,
      rows: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
      ],
    },
    {
      speed: 400,
      rows: [
        '..222222..',
        '.21111112.',
        '2112222112',
        '2121111212',
        '2112222112',
        '.21111112.',
        '..222222..',
      ],
    },
  ];

  // ---------- State ----------
  const game = {
    state: 'title',   // title | serve | play | paused | levelClear | gameOver | win
    prevState: 'serve',
    stateTime: 0,
    level: 0,
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    best: loadBest(),
    shake: 0,
  };
  const paddle = { x: (W - PADDLE_W) / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H };
  const ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, r: BALL_R, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: LEVELS[0].speed };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };
  let bricks = [];
  let bricksLeft = 0;
  let particles = [];

  function loadBest() {
    try { return Number(localStorage.getItem('brickBreakerBest')) || 0; } catch (e) { return 0; }
  }
  function saveBest() {
    if (game.score > game.best) {
      game.best = game.score;
      try { localStorage.setItem('brickBreakerBest', String(game.best)); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }

  function clamp(v, min, max) { return v < min ? min : v > max ? max : v; }

  function setState(s) {
    game.state = s;
    game.stateTime = 0;
  }

  // ---------- Level / game flow ----------
  function buildLevel(index) {
    bricks = [];
    LEVELS[index].rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch !== '1' && ch !== '2') continue;
        const hp = Number(ch);
        bricks.push({
          x: BRICK_MARGIN + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
          y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
          w: BRICK_W,
          h: BRICK_H,
          hp,
          maxHp: hp,
          color: hp === 2 ? STEEL : ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
          alive: true,
          flash: 0,
        });
      }
    });
    bricksLeft = bricks.length;
  }

  function loadLevel(index) {
    game.level = index;
    buildLevel(index);
    particles = [];
    paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
    resetBall();
  }

  function startGame() {
    game.score = 0;
    game.lives = 3;
    loadLevel(0);
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.speed = LEVELS[game.level].speed;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
    stickBallToPaddle();
    setState('serve');
  }

  function stickBallToPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }

  function launchBall() {
    let angle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
    if (keys.left && !keys.right) angle = -0.35;
    if (keys.right && !keys.left) angle = 0.35;
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    setState('play');
  }

  function loseLife() {
    game.lives--;
    game.shake = 0.35;
    if (game.lives <= 0) {
      saveBest();
      setState('gameOver');
    } else {
      resetBall();
    }
  }

  function levelCleared() {
    game.score += LEVEL_BONUS;
    if (game.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
      setState('levelClear');
    } else {
      saveBest();
      setState('win');
    }
  }

  // Primary action: Space / Enter / Up / click / tap
  function action() {
    switch (game.state) {
      case 'title':
        startGame();
        break;
      case 'serve':
        launchBall();
        break;
      case 'paused':
        game.state = game.prevState;
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        if (game.stateTime > 0.4) loadLevel(game.level + 1);
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
      case 'win':
        if (game.stateTime > 0.6) startGame();
        break;
    }
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (game.state === 'play' || game.state === 'serve') {
      game.prevState = game.state;
      game.state = 'paused';
    } else if (game.state === 'paused') {
      game.state = game.prevState;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const DIR_KEYS = { ArrowLeft: 'left', KeyA: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', KeyD: 'right' };

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const code = e.code || (e.key === ' ' ? 'Space' : e.key);
    const dir = DIR_KEYS[code];
    if (dir) {
      keys[dir] = true;
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    switch (code) {
      case 'Space':
      case 'Enter':
      case 'NumpadEnter':
      case 'ArrowUp':
      case 'KeyW':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!e.repeat) action();
        break;
      case 'KeyP':
      case 'Escape':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
        break;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    const code = e.code || e.key;
    const dir = DIR_KEYS[code];
    if (dir) keys[dir] = false;
  });

  function movePaddleTo(clientX) {
    if (game.state !== 'play' && game.state !== 'serve') return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    paddle.x = clamp(x - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
  }

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => movePaddleTo(e.clientX));
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    movePaddleTo(e.clientX);
    action();
  });
  window.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = keys.right = false;
    if (game.state === 'play' || game.state === 'serve') togglePause();
  });

  // ---------- Physics ----------
  function normalizeBall() {
    const len = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) || 1;
    ball.vx = (ball.vx / len) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = (ball.vy / len) * ball.speed;
  }

  function damageBrick(b) {
    b.hp--;
    if (b.hp <= 0) {
      b.alive = false;
      bricksLeft--;
      game.score += b.maxHp === 2 ? 25 : 10;
      spawnParticles(b);
    } else {
      game.score += 5;
      b.flash = 0.15;
    }
    ball.speed = Math.min(ball.speed + SPEED_STEP, MAX_SPEED);
    normalizeBall();
  }

  // Circle vs. rectangle; resolves at most one brick per sub-step.
  function collideBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const nx = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
      const ny = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
      const dx = ball.x - nx, dy = ball.y - ny;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) continue;

      const bcx = b.x + b.w / 2, bcy = b.y + b.h / 2;
      const overlapX = b.w / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.x - bcx);
      const overlapY = b.h / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.y - bcy);
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        const s = ball.x < bcx ? -1 : 1;
        ball.vx = s * Math.abs(ball.vx);
        ball.x += s * overlapX;
      } else {
        const s = ball.y < bcy ? -1 : 1;
        ball.vy = s * Math.abs(ball.vy);
        ball.y += s * overlapY;
      }
      damageBrick(b);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function collidePaddle() {
    if (ball.vy <= 0) return;
    if (ball.y + ball.r < paddle.y || ball.y > paddle.y + paddle.h) return;
    if (ball.x + ball.r < paddle.x || ball.x - ball.r > paddle.x + paddle.w) return;
    const hit = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r), -1, 1);
    const angle = hit * MAX_BOUNCE;
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  }

  // ---------- Particles ----------
  function spawnParticles(b) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const life = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4;
      particles.push({
        x: b.x + Math.random() * b.w,
        y: b.y + Math.random() * b.h,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 280,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.7) * 260,
        life,
        maxLife: life,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        color: b.color,
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (const p of particles) {
      p.vy += 600 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
    }
    particles = particles.filter((p) => p.life > 0);
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (game.state === 'paused') return;
    game.stateTime += dt;
    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt);
    updateParticles(dt);
    for (const b of bricks) if (b.flash > 0) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt);

    if (game.state !== 'play' && game.state !== 'serve') return;

    const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
    if (dir) paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt, 0, W - paddle.w);

    if (game.state === 'serve') {
      stickBallToPaddle();
      return;
    }

    // Sub-steps keep the ball from tunnelling through bricks at high speed.
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((ball.speed * dt) / (ball.r * 0.5)));
    const sdt = dt / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      ball.x += ball.vx * sdt;
      ball.y += ball.vy * sdt;

      if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

      collidePaddle();

      if (collideBricks() && bricksLeft === 0) {
        levelCleared();
        return;
      }

      if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
        loseLife();
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Rendering ----------
  const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#151a35');
  bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#0b0e1e');

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBrick(b) {
    const cracked = b.maxHp === 2 && b.hp === 1;
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = cracked ? STEEL_CRACKED : b.color;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 3);

    if (b.maxHp === 2) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,50,70,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      if (cracked) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.30, b.y);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.42, b.y + b.h * 0.50);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.34, b.y + b.h);
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.42, b.y + b.h * 0.50);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.62, b.y + b.h * 0.38);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.72, b.y + b.h);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        roundRect(b.x + 3, b.y + 3, b.w - 6, b.h - 6, 3);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    if (b.flash > 0) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(b.flash / 0.15) * 0.75})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#7ef9ff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1e90ff');
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,200,255,0.6)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(160,220,255,0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0d1c';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,150,255,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 2, W, 2);

    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const y = HUD_H / 2;

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(`SCORE ${game.score}`, 16, y);
    ctx.font = `15px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8f9bc4';
    ctx.fillText(`BEST ${Math.max(game.best, game.score)}`, 190, y);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
    ctx.fillText(`LEVEL ${game.level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, y);

    // Lives: filled circles for remaining, outlines for lost
    const total = 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
      const cx = W - 24 - i * 24;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      if (total - 1 - i < game.lives) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5e7e';
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,94,126,0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', W - 24 - total * 24 + 6, y);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, titleColor, lines) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,8,20,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = `bold 54px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = titleColor;
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 80);
    ctx.font = `20px ${FONT}`;
    lines.forEach((line, i) => {
      const isPrompt = i === lines.length - 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = isPrompt ? '#7ef9ff' : '#dfe6f5';
      if (isPrompt) ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
      ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, H / 2 - 10 + i * 32);
    });
  }

  function render(time) {
    ctx.save();
    if (game.shake > 0) {
      const m = game.shake * 18;
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

    for (const b of bricks) if (b.alive) drawBrick(b);
    drawParticles();
    drawPaddle();
    if (game.state !== 'gameOver' && game.state !== 'win' && game.state !== 'title') drawBall();

    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();

    const blink = Math.floor(time * 2) % 2 === 0;
    switch (game.state) {
      case 'title':
        drawOverlay('BRICK BREAKER', '#7ef9ff', [
          'Mouse: move to steer the paddle, click to launch',
          'Keyboard: ← → or A / D to move, Space to launch',
          'P or Esc: pause      2 levels · 3 lives',
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to start',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'serve':
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.font = `bold 40px ${FONT}`;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
        ctx.fillText(`LEVEL ${game.level + 1}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
        if (blink) {
          ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#7ef9ff';
          ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or CLICK to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 95);
        }
        break;
      case 'paused':
        drawOverlay('PAUSED', '#feca57', [
          'Mouse or ← → / A D to move the paddle',
          '',
          'Press P, Esc, SPACE or CLICK to resume',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        drawOverlay(`LEVEL ${game.level + 1} CLEAR!`, '#1dd1a1', [
          `Level bonus +${LEVEL_BONUS}    Score: ${game.score}`,
          'Next up: silver bricks take 2 hits!',
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to continue',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
        drawOverlay('GAME OVER', '#ff5e7e', [
          `Final score: ${game.score}`,
          `Best: ${game.best}`,
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to play again',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'win':
        drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', '#feca57', [
          `All levels cleared! Final score: ${game.score}`,
          `Best: ${game.best}`,
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to play again',
        ]);
        break;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  buildLevel(0);
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
    last = now;
    update(Math.max(0, dt));
    render(now / 1000);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
    last = t;
    frame(t);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  resize();

  // ---------- Constants ----------
  const PADDLE_W = 110, PADDLE_H = 14, PADDLE_Y = H - 40, PADDLE_SPEED = 640;
  const BALL_R = 8;
  const MAX_BOUNCE = Math.PI / 3;      // max angle from vertical off the paddle
  const SPEED_STEP = 2.5;              // ball speeds up a bit on every brick hit
  const MAX_SPEED = 600;
  const LEVEL_BONUS = 500;

  const COLS = 10, BRICK_GAP = 6, BRICK_MARGIN = 30, BRICK_H = 22, BRICK_TOP = 80;
  const BRICK_W = (W - BRICK_MARGIN * 2 - BRICK_GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
  const ROW_COLORS = ['#ff5e7e', '#ff9f43', '#feca57', '#1dd1a1', '#54a0ff', '#a29bfe', '#ff6bcb'];
  const STEEL = '#b8c4d6', STEEL_CRACKED = '#7d8a9c';

  // '1' = normal brick (1 hit), '2' = silver brick (2 hits), '.' = empty
  const LEVELS = [
    {
      speed: 340,
      rows: [
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
        '1111111111',
      ],
    },
    {
      speed: 400,
      rows: [
        '..222222..',
        '.21111112.',
        '2112222112',
        '2121111212',
        '2112222112',
        '.21111112.',
        '..222222..',
      ],
    },
  ];

  // ---------- State ----------
  const game = {
    state: 'title',   // title | serve | play | paused | levelClear | gameOver | win
    prevState: 'serve',
    stateTime: 0,
    level: 0,
    score: 0,
    lives: 3,
    best: loadBest(),
    shake: 0,
  };
  const paddle = { x: (W - PADDLE_W) / 2, y: PADDLE_Y, w: PADDLE_W, h: PADDLE_H };
  const ball = { x: W / 2, y: PADDLE_Y - BALL_R - 1, r: BALL_R, vx: 0, vy: 0, speed: LEVELS[0].speed };
  const keys = { left: false, right: false };
  let bricks = [];
  let bricksLeft = 0;
  let particles = [];

  function loadBest() {
    try { return Number(localStorage.getItem('brickBreakerBest')) || 0; } catch (e) { return 0; }
  }
  function saveBest() {
    if (game.score > game.best) {
      game.best = game.score;
      try { localStorage.setItem('brickBreakerBest', String(game.best)); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
  }

  function clamp(v, min, max) { return v < min ? min : v > max ? max : v; }

  function setState(s) {
    game.state = s;
    game.stateTime = 0;
  }

  // ---------- Level / game flow ----------
  function buildLevel(index) {
    bricks = [];
    LEVELS[index].rows.forEach((row, r) => {
      for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
        const ch = row[c];
        if (ch !== '1' && ch !== '2') continue;
        const hp = Number(ch);
        bricks.push({
          x: BRICK_MARGIN + c * (BRICK_W + BRICK_GAP),
          y: BRICK_TOP + r * (BRICK_H + BRICK_GAP),
          w: BRICK_W,
          h: BRICK_H,
          hp,
          maxHp: hp,
          color: hp === 2 ? STEEL : ROW_COLORS[r % ROW_COLORS.length],
          alive: true,
          flash: 0,
        });
      }
    });
    bricksLeft = bricks.length;
  }

  function loadLevel(index) {
    game.level = index;
    buildLevel(index);
    particles = [];
    paddle.x = (W - paddle.w) / 2;
    resetBall();
  }

  function startGame() {
    game.score = 0;
    game.lives = 3;
    loadLevel(0);
  }

  function resetBall() {
    ball.speed = LEVELS[game.level].speed;
    ball.vx = 0;
    ball.vy = 0;
    stickBallToPaddle();
    setState('serve');
  }

  function stickBallToPaddle() {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
  }

  function launchBall() {
    let angle = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
    if (keys.left && !keys.right) angle = -0.35;
    if (keys.right && !keys.left) angle = 0.35;
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    setState('play');
  }

  function loseLife() {
    game.lives--;
    game.shake = 0.35;
    if (game.lives <= 0) {
      saveBest();
      setState('gameOver');
    } else {
      resetBall();
    }
  }

  function levelCleared() {
    game.score += LEVEL_BONUS;
    if (game.level + 1 < LEVELS.length) {
      setState('levelClear');
    } else {
      saveBest();
      setState('win');
    }
  }

  // Primary action: Space / Enter / Up / click / tap
  function action() {
    switch (game.state) {
      case 'title':
        startGame();
        break;
      case 'serve':
        launchBall();
        break;
      case 'paused':
        game.state = game.prevState;
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        if (game.stateTime > 0.4) loadLevel(game.level + 1);
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
      case 'win':
        if (game.stateTime > 0.6) startGame();
        break;
    }
  }

  function togglePause() {
    if (game.state === 'play' || game.state === 'serve') {
      game.prevState = game.state;
      game.state = 'paused';
    } else if (game.state === 'paused') {
      game.state = game.prevState;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Input ----------
  const DIR_KEYS = { ArrowLeft: 'left', KeyA: 'left', ArrowRight: 'right', KeyD: 'right' };

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const code = e.code || (e.key === ' ' ? 'Space' : e.key);
    const dir = DIR_KEYS[code];
    if (dir) {
      keys[dir] = true;
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    switch (code) {
      case 'Space':
      case 'Enter':
      case 'NumpadEnter':
      case 'ArrowUp':
      case 'KeyW':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!e.repeat) action();
        break;
      case 'KeyP':
      case 'Escape':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!e.repeat) togglePause();
        break;
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
    const code = e.code || e.key;
    const dir = DIR_KEYS[code];
    if (dir) keys[dir] = false;
  });

  function movePaddleTo(clientX) {
    if (game.state !== 'play' && game.state !== 'serve') return;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = (clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    paddle.x = clamp(x - paddle.w / 2, 0, W - paddle.w);
  }

  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => movePaddleTo(e.clientX));
  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    movePaddleTo(e.clientX);
    action();
  });
  window.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => e.preventDefault());

  window.addEventListener('blur', () => {
    keys.left = keys.right = false;
    if (game.state === 'play' || game.state === 'serve') togglePause();
  });

  // ---------- Physics ----------
  function normalizeBall() {
    const len = Math.hypot(ball.vx, ball.vy) || 1;
    ball.vx = (ball.vx / len) * ball.speed;
    ball.vy = (ball.vy / len) * ball.speed;
  }

  function damageBrick(b) {
    b.hp--;
    if (b.hp <= 0) {
      b.alive = false;
      bricksLeft--;
      game.score += b.maxHp === 2 ? 25 : 10;
      spawnParticles(b);
    } else {
      game.score += 5;
      b.flash = 0.15;
    }
    ball.speed = Math.min(ball.speed + SPEED_STEP, MAX_SPEED);
    normalizeBall();
  }

  // Circle vs. rectangle; resolves at most one brick per sub-step.
  function collideBricks() {
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const nx = clamp(ball.x, b.x, b.x + b.w);
      const ny = clamp(ball.y, b.y, b.y + b.h);
      const dx = ball.x - nx, dy = ball.y - ny;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy > ball.r * ball.r) continue;

      const bcx = b.x + b.w / 2, bcy = b.y + b.h / 2;
      const overlapX = b.w / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.x - bcx);
      const overlapY = b.h / 2 + ball.r - Math.abs(ball.y - bcy);
      if (overlapX < overlapY) {
        const s = ball.x < bcx ? -1 : 1;
        ball.vx = s * Math.abs(ball.vx);
        ball.x += s * overlapX;
      } else {
        const s = ball.y < bcy ? -1 : 1;
        ball.vy = s * Math.abs(ball.vy);
        ball.y += s * overlapY;
      }
      damageBrick(b);
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function collidePaddle() {
    if (ball.vy <= 0) return;
    if (ball.y + ball.r < paddle.y || ball.y > paddle.y + paddle.h) return;
    if (ball.x + ball.r < paddle.x || ball.x - ball.r > paddle.x + paddle.w) return;
    const hit = clamp((ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2 + ball.r), -1, 1);
    const angle = hit * MAX_BOUNCE;
    ball.vx = ball.speed * Math.sin(angle);
    ball.vy = -ball.speed * Math.cos(angle);
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
  }

  // ---------- Particles ----------
  function spawnParticles(b) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const life = 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.4;
      particles.push({
        x: b.x + Math.random() * b.w,
        y: b.y + Math.random() * b.h,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 280,
        vy: (Math.random() - 0.7) * 260,
        life,
        maxLife: life,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 3,
        color: b.color,
      });
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (const p of particles) {
      p.vy += 600 * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.life -= dt;
    }
    particles = particles.filter((p) => p.life > 0);
  }

  // ---------- Update ----------
  function update(dt) {
    if (game.state === 'paused') return;
    game.stateTime += dt;
    game.shake = Math.max(0, game.shake - dt);
    updateParticles(dt);
    for (const b of bricks) if (b.flash > 0) b.flash = Math.max(0, b.flash - dt);

    if (game.state !== 'play' && game.state !== 'serve') return;

    const dir = (keys.right ? 1 : 0) - (keys.left ? 1 : 0);
    if (dir) paddle.x = clamp(paddle.x + dir * PADDLE_SPEED * dt, 0, W - paddle.w);

    if (game.state === 'serve') {
      stickBallToPaddle();
      return;
    }

    // Sub-steps keep the ball from tunnelling through bricks at high speed.
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((ball.speed * dt) / (ball.r * 0.5)));
    const sdt = dt / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      ball.x += ball.vx * sdt;
      ball.y += ball.vy * sdt;

      if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.vx = Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      else if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.vx = -Math.abs(ball.vx); }
      if (ball.y - ball.r < HUD_H) { ball.y = HUD_H + ball.r; ball.vy = Math.abs(ball.vy); }

      collidePaddle();

      if (collideBricks() && bricksLeft === 0) {
        levelCleared();
        return;
      }

      if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
        loseLife();
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------- Rendering ----------
  const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#151a35');
  bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#0b0e1e');

  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBrick(b) {
    const cracked = b.maxHp === 2 && b.hp === 1;
    roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = cracked ? STEEL_CRACKED : b.color;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.28)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + 3, b.w - 8, 4);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)';
    ctx.fillRect(b.x + 4, b.y + b.h - 5, b.w - 8, 3);

    if (b.maxHp === 2) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(40,50,70,0.55)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      if (cracked) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.30, b.y);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.42, b.y + b.h * 0.50);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.34, b.y + b.h);
        ctx.moveTo(b.x + b.w * 0.42, b.y + b.h * 0.50);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.62, b.y + b.h * 0.38);
        ctx.lineTo(b.x + b.w * 0.72, b.y + b.h);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        roundRect(b.x + 3, b.y + 3, b.w - 6, b.h - 6, 3);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    if (b.flash > 0) {
      roundRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(b.flash / 0.15) * 0.75})`;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  function drawPaddle() {
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, paddle.y, 0, paddle.y + paddle.h);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#7ef9ff');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#1e90ff');
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(80,200,255,0.6)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    roundRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h, 7);
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function drawBall() {
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(160,220,255,0.9)';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    for (const p of particles) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawHUD() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0d1c';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, HUD_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,150,255,0.35)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H - 2, W, 2);

    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const y = HUD_H / 2;

    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText(`SCORE ${game.score}`, 16, y);
    ctx.font = `15px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8f9bc4';
    ctx.fillText(`BEST ${Math.max(game.best, game.score)}`, 190, y);

    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#feca57';
    ctx.fillText(`LEVEL ${game.level + 1} / ${LEVELS.length}`, W / 2, y);

    // Lives: filled circles for remaining, outlines for lost
    const total = 3;
    for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
      const cx = W - 24 - i * 24;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      if (total - 1 - i < game.lives) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5e7e';
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,94,126,0.5)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillText('LIVES', W - 24 - total * 24 + 6, y);
  }

  function drawOverlay(title, titleColor, lines) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,8,20,0.75)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, HUD_H, W, H - HUD_H);
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.font = `bold 54px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = titleColor;
    ctx.fillText(title, W / 2, H / 2 - 80);
    ctx.font = `20px ${FONT}`;
    lines.forEach((line, i) => {
      const isPrompt = i === lines.length - 1;
      ctx.fillStyle = isPrompt ? '#7ef9ff' : '#dfe6f5';
      if (isPrompt) ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
      ctx.fillText(line, W / 2, H / 2 - 10 + i * 32);
    });
  }

  function render(time) {
    ctx.save();
    if (game.shake > 0) {
      const m = game.shake * 18;
      ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * m, (Math.random() - 0.5) * m);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
    ctx.fillRect(-20, -20, W + 40, H + 40);

    for (const b of bricks) if (b.alive) drawBrick(b);
    drawParticles();
    drawPaddle();
    if (game.state !== 'gameOver' && game.state !== 'win' && game.state !== 'title') drawBall();

    ctx.restore();
    drawHUD();

    const blink = Math.floor(time * 2) % 2 === 0;
    switch (game.state) {
      case 'title':
        drawOverlay('BRICK BREAKER', '#7ef9ff', [
          'Mouse: move to steer the paddle, click to launch',
          'Keyboard: ← → or A / D to move, Space to launch',
          'P or Esc: pause      2 levels · 3 lives',
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to start',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'serve':
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.font = `bold 40px ${FONT}`;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
        ctx.fillText(`LEVEL ${game.level + 1}`, W / 2, H / 2 + 50);
        if (blink) {
          ctx.font = `bold 20px ${FONT}`;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#7ef9ff';
          ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or CLICK to launch', W / 2, H / 2 + 95);
        }
        break;
      case 'paused':
        drawOverlay('PAUSED', '#feca57', [
          'Mouse or ← → / A D to move the paddle',
          '',
          'Press P, Esc, SPACE or CLICK to resume',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'levelClear':
        drawOverlay(`LEVEL ${game.level + 1} CLEAR!`, '#1dd1a1', [
          `Level bonus +${LEVEL_BONUS}    Score: ${game.score}`,
          'Next up: silver bricks take 2 hits!',
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to continue',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'gameOver':
        drawOverlay('GAME OVER', '#ff5e7e', [
          `Final score: ${game.score}`,
          `Best: ${game.best}`,
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to play again',
        ]);
        break;
      case 'win':
        drawOverlay('YOU WIN!', '#feca57', [
          `All levels cleared! Final score: ${game.score}`,
          `Best: ${game.best}`,
          '',
          'Press SPACE or CLICK to play again',
        ]);
        break;
    }
  }

  // ---------- Main loop ----------
  buildLevel(0);
  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min((now - last) / 1000, 1 / 30);
    last = now;
    update(Math.max(0, dt));
    render(now / 1000);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame((t) => {
    last = t;
    frame(t);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

I've written the game to `index.html` in the current folder. Open it in any browser to play; it needs no other files and no internet. I haven't run it in a browser yet, and my automatic syntax check was blocked waiting for your approval, so the code hasn't been tested.

**What's in it:**
- **2 levels:** Level 1 is five rows of bricks that break in one hit. Level 2 has a ring layout where the silver bricks need two hits and show cracks after the first. The ball starts faster in level 2 and speeds up a little with every brick you hit.
- **Score:** shown at the top left. A normal brick is worth 10 points, a silver brick 5 for the first hit and 25 when it breaks, and you get 500 for clearing a level. Your best score is also shown and is kept between sessions.
- **3 lives:** shown as three dots at the top right. Losing the ball costs a life and puts a new ball on the paddle. At zero you get a Game Over screen with your final score.
- **Screens:** title, level cleared, game over and a win screen after level 2.

**Controls:**

| Action | Mouse / touch | Keyboard |
|---|---|---|
| Move paddle | Move the mouse | ← → or A / D |
| Launch ball / continue | Click or tap | Space, Enter or ↑ |
| Pause / resume | Click to resume | P or Esc |

The keyboard controls also work when a Korean input mode is switched on. The ball bounces off the paddle at a sharper angle the closer it hits the edge. The game pauses by itself if you switch to another window.
